text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The section advises and supports the Federal Administration in all matters relating to communication and creates a wide range of communication products.", "gist": "The section advises and supports the Federal Administration on all communication matters and produces various communication products."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Strategic Management Support Section", "gist": "Strategic Management Support Section"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "has the task of drafting the Federal Council’s planning and activity reports", "gist": "Must draft the Federal Council’s planning and activity reports"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "provides crisis management training to the Federal Administration", "gist": "Must provide crisis management training to the Federal Administration"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Presidential Services Unit", "gist": "Presidential Services Unit"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "which has been part of the Federal Chancellery since 2015", "gist": "The Presidential Services Unit has been part of the Federal Chancellery since 2015"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "supports the president’s department in carrying out the additional tasks arising in the presidential year", "gist": "Must support the president’s department in carrying out additional tasks during the presidential year"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "provides advice on matters of diplomacy and communication", "gist": "Provides advice on diplomacy and communication matters"}]}
